criteria.criterion: `vloop brief review <path>` takes exactly one argument (otherwise exit 2), a loop brief at any status; it refuses an existing non-brief path with `vloop: not a loop brief: <path>` (exit 2), a missing one with `vloop: no such file: <path>` (exit 1), and outside a vloop repository `vloop: not in a vloop repository — run vloop init first` (exit 1), each before any session or folder.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/brief_review.go:20-73 and brief_review_test.go:TestBriefReviewRefusalsRunNoSession assert each code and message and that .vloop/state is not created

criteria.criterion: It takes the working tree's lock as vloop run does — a live loop refused with vloop run's `vloop: a loop is already running in this working tree (pid …` message, exit 1, its lock untouched — holds it during the session and releases it at the end; it then clears .vloop/tmp/ as vloop run does at start. Its preflight checks only what one session of its agent needs: for Claude, claude on PATH and the trust check, printed as `  ✗ <name> <message>` then `vloop: preflight failed — <n> problem(s), nothing has run`, exit 1, with no session and no folder.
criteria.evidence: The lock, release and ClearTmp are in briefreview.go:69-75 and briefReviewPreflight is in brief_review.go:105-127. The lock refusal and release are tested. The preflight code is correct but untested (see the finding).

criteria.criterion: It prints `reviewing <path> using <model> (agent <agent>)` on stderr and runs one session, phase review-brief, prompt `/vloop:review-brief <path>`, with the model and effort P-6 resolves (config file and VLOOP_MODEL_REVIEW_BRIEF / VLOOP_EFFORT_REVIEW_BRIEF), the run.session-timeout timeout and, for Claude, fence/review-brief.json as its settings. Its folder is .vloop/state/brief-reviews/<run id>/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>/ with sessions/001-review-brief.json: session/v5, run_id the brief's run id, iteration 0, phase review-brief. A session that cannot start is `vloop: brief review session failed: <error>`, exit 7.
criteria.evidence: briefreview.go:94-103, 152-163; TestBriefReviewFixKeepsReportAndRecord asserts stderr line, record fields, argv prompt, model and fence path

criteria.criterion: After the session the brief is restored first if its bytes changed; then, in this order and with these exact lines (folder repo-relative, no trailing slash): git config or hooks changed → `vloop: the brief review changed <what> — nothing was committed; restore it, then re-run` (exit 9, <what> as the gate review names it); refs moved → `vloop: REFS MOVED review-brief — the brief review changed git refs; nothing was committed` (exit 9); brief changed → `vloop: the brief review changed <path>; it was restored` (exit 9); timed out → `vloop: brief review session timed out after <timeout> — see <folder>` (exit 7); non-zero exit → `vloop: brief review session failed (<agent> exited <n>) — see <folder>` (exit 7); no report → `vloop: the brief review left no .vloop/tmp/brief-review.json — see <folder>` (exit 7); a report failing brief-review/v1 or naming another brief → `vloop: the brief review's .vloop/tmp/brief-review.json does not follow brief-review/v1 — see <folder>` (exit 7), with nothing kept as brief-review.json.
criteria.evidence: briefreview.go:105-135 follows this order and wording; TestBriefReviewPlantedFailures and TestBriefReviewTimeout cover each case

criteria.criterion: A valid report is kept masked as <folder>/brief-review.json and printed on stdout as `verdict: <V> — <n> finding(s)`, one `  <kind padded to 12>  <section>: <summary>` line per finding in order, and `kept: <folder>/brief-review.json`; exit 0 on PASS, 1 on FIX or ASK, with no `vloop:` line. A report printed or kept without validating it is a violation.
criteria.evidence: briefreview.go:131-147 validates before keeping, masks and prints; brief_review.go:97 exits 1 with an empty error; the exact stdout is asserted in the FIX test

criteria.criterion: The command commits nothing, moves no ref, touches no plan or run state, and writes only its folder, .vloop/tmp/ and (when restoring) the brief. vloop run and every loop session, record and message are unchanged; loop sessions keep session/v3 and session/v4, and a session/v5 record for any other phase, or a v3/v4 one for review-brief, is a violation.
criteria.evidence: session.go record switch gives v5 only for review-brief and leaves the other phases' v3/v4 logic as it was

criteria.criterion: The three keys are documented in docs/guide/configuration.md and docs/guide/commands.md is regenerated in this task; `vloop config set agent.review-brief` accepts claude and copilot and refuses anything else with exit 2.
criteria.evidence: configuration.md rows added; commands.md has the vloop brief review section; TestConfigSetAgentReviewBrief

criteria.criterion: Committed Go tests, with a stub claude and fixtures in temporary directories addressed with git -C, cover the FIX and PASS runs (output, exit, record, argv, fence), the lock refusal, the preflight refusals and every planted failure of the worked example (no report, verdict OK, FIX with no findings, another brief's name, exit 3, git config, moved HEAD, a changed brief) and the timeout; the config keys' list test changes only to add the three keys (work notes name R1). No test or gate runs claude, copilot, gh or the network.
criteria.evidence: The FIX, PASS, lock, planted-failure and timeout tests exist. No committed test covers the preflight refusals (claude missing from PATH, folder untrusted, the `  ✗ ...` lines, `preflight failed — n problem(s), nothing has run`, exit 1, no folder). grep finds no preflight test in internal/cli/brief_review_test.go or internal/driver/briefreview_test.go.

findings.summary: The preflight refusals (briefReviewPreflight: claude not on PATH, folder not trusted, exit 1, no session or folder) have no committed test, though the criterion lists them

notes: Besides the missing preflight test, the implementation matches the brief. The CLI creates .vloop/tmp before the path refusals, which is harmless because only .vloop/state is checked. Copilot preflight is deferred to T4 as the goal says.
